summary: Iteration 61 — RouteMail Phase 2 Batch B (Unibox rebuild) end-to-end PASSED. Backend pytest: created /app/backend/tests/test_iter61_phase2_batch_b.py with 30 cases across 6 classes (TestListReplies x15, TestMoveReplies x5, TestArchiveReplies x2, TestDeleteReplies x3, TestDomainDNE x4, TestFoldersRegression x1). All 30 PASS in 2.28s (100%). Coverage: (1) GET /api/unibox/replies — all new query params verified independently: unread_only, archived (default excludes, archived=true returns only archived), campaign_id, drip_id, account_id, folder_id incl. '__unassigned__'=null match, domain regex (from_email suffix match), date_preset last_7 vs 40-day-old row filtering, q free-text across from_email/subject/body/campaign_name/drip_campaign_name/received_on_email, sort_by whitelist fallback (invalid 'drop_table; DROP' falls back silently — no 500), sort_by=from_email asc lexicographic, limit=600 returns 422 (Pydantic Query le=500), pagination via skip yields disjoint pages, enrichment fields populated (domain parsed from from_email, folder_name joined from lead_folders, sending_account_email joined from email_accounts). (2) POST /api/unibox/replies/move — moves to folder, moves to unassigned (folder_id=None when body folder_id omitted), 404 on foldr_nope, 400 on empty reply_ids, cross-tenant silent (modified=0, doc untouched). (3) POST /api/unibox/replies/archive — archive→GET excludes; archived=true→returns; unarchive flips back; empty 400. (4) POST /api/unibox/replies/delete — deletes seeded row (deleted=1), 400 on empty, cross-tenant returns deleted=0 + foreign doc intact. (5) POST /api/unibox/dne/domain/preview — returns {domain,lead_count,list_contact_count,drip_contact_count,reply_count,estimated_suppressed} with correct counts after seeding leads on that domain; invalid empty 400; invalid 'no-tld-here' 400. (6) POST /api/unibox/dne/domain — first call adds wildcard '@dom' with source='unibox_domain', second call returns {added:false, message:'Already suppressed'}, idempotent; '@' alone returns 400. (7) Regression GET /api/leads/folders — still returns folders[] with reply_count + lead_count + top-level unassigned_reply_count. Regression: re-ran iter59 Phase 2 Batch A (24) + iter60 Phase 2 Batch C (26) = 50/50 PASS. Domain column shows 'bigcorp-iter61.com' (server-enriched from from_email). Selecting all rows reveals bulk-bar with all 7 buttons (bulk-mark-read, bulk-mark-unread, bulk-move, bulk-archive, bulk-delete, bulk-save-lead, bulk-add-dne). bulk-move opens move-dialog with move-folder-select + move-confirm + move-cancel. Per-row reply-domain-dne-<id> button opens domain-dne-dialog with domain-dne-preview text 'This will suppress approximately: 0 lead(s) 0 contact(s) on email lists 0 drip contact(s) 3 existing repl(y/ies) tracked' + domain-dne-confirm + domain-dne-cancel (cancels cleanly without firing the POST). unibox-pagination correctly absent because total=3 < limit=50 (only renders when total > limit). All seeded data (TEST_iter61_* + TEST_iter61ui_* across user_sessions, lead_folders, email_accounts, replies, leads, dne_emails, dne_lists) cleaned post-run. Mongo verified clean.

ui_bugs.issue: React hydration warning logged twice on /unibox: '<span> cannot be a child of <tr>' and '<span> cannot be a child of <tbody>'. The wrapping element is `<span data-ve-dynamic="true" x-excluded="true" style={{display:"contents"}}>` which is injected by the visual-editor instrumentation around <tbody>/<tr>. Page renders correctly but warning is noisy (same root cause as iter60 — visual-editor wrapper on iterated table rows + tbody). Either suppress data-ve-dynamic wrappers on table descendants, or render rows outside an iterable wrapper.

Console warning: 'Missing Description or aria-describedby={undefined} for {DialogContent}.' fires on both move-dialog and domain-dne-dialog. Add a <DialogDescription> (or aria-describedby prop) under each DialogContent for screen-reader accessibility.

issues: When filter-date-preset='custom', the filter-date-from / filter-date-to inputs use the browser-default <input type=date> picker (mm/dd/yyyy) instead of the shadcn Calendar/Popover used elsewhere — same inconsistency flagged on /sent-emails in iter60.

action_items: (LOW) Suppress / move the visual-editor's `<span data-ve-dynamic>` wrapper that's emitting `<span>` as direct child of `<tbody>` / `<tr>` on /unibox (and previously /sent-emails). React hydration warnings only; page renders fine.
(LOW) Add a DialogDescription (or aria-describedby) to both move-dialog and domain-dne-dialog's DialogContent in Unibox.jsx for accessibility.
(LOW) Replace `<input type='date'>` on the custom date range with shadcn Calendar popovers for visual consistency.
critical_code_review_comments: unibox_routes.py list_replies cleanly composes a single Mongo query — filters, sort_by whitelist, limit clamp via Pydantic Query (ge=1, le=500), pagination via skip/limit, and a single enrichment $in lookup per related collection (lead_folders + email_accounts) avoiding N+1. Excellent. Tested cross-tenant isolation via user_id scoping on all bulk endpoints — verified empirically (modified=0 / deleted=0 on foreign reply_ids).

Domain DNE endpoints reject '@' / empty / no-TLD inputs with 400 and store '@domain.com' wildcard entries with source='unibox_domain'. Idempotency check (find_one before insert) is correct — second call returns added:false. Note: dne_emails uniqueness is enforced application-side (no unique index on {list_id,user_id,email}) — consider adding for race-safety if multiple browser tabs hit this concurrently.

archived filter semantics: default excludes (archived:{$ne:true}), archived=true returns ONLY archived. This means there is no current way to fetch BOTH archived+non-archived in one call. Acceptable per spec; document if user wants 'all'.
date_preset overrides date_from/date_to silently if both provided. The endpoint accepts both but preset wins. Minor footgun — fine as-is.

Free-text q search uses unescaped regex — passing '.*' or '(?P<n>x)' would still be parsed by Mongo. No injection risk (Mongo regex isn't shell-injectable), but a malicious user could pass an ReDoS-prone pattern. Consider re.escape() before composing the regex.
Bulk endpoints all use db.replies.update_many / delete_many with {user_id: user.user_id, reply_id: {$in: req.reply_ids}} — naturally cross-tenant safe (verified).
Unibox.jsx is now ~1180 lines — over the 700-line guideline. Consider splitting filter-bar, bulk-bar, and the two dialogs into sub-components for maintainability.
submitMove (bulk) issues a single POST /unibox/replies/move with the full reply_ids list — correct batched call.
confirmSingleDomainDne triggers the POST after preview load — UX flow matches the spec (preview → confirm → toast).
Window.confirm() is used for delete confirmation (per agent note for speed) — works but inconsistent with the shadcn dialog pattern used everywhere else. Low priority.
